v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: When resources with atleast one spare existing and requests within capacities when is allocation - feasible is called then its true
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: When requester whose totals exactly equal every available resource's capacity when the allocation is evaluated the allocation is invalid
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_4: When any resource whose total requested amount exceeding capacity when the allocation is evaluated then allocation is invalid
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_5: Given no requests and atleast one available resource when the allocation is evaluated then allocation is valid
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: When a malformed request entry that is not a mapping of resources name to amounts when the allocation is evaluated then the system releases error

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: All resource capacities and req amounts are non negative
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Atleast one resource must remain unallocated
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: Resource name and keys are non empty strings
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_4: The user will provide valid input types
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: The system operates in single threaded
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_6: Resource capacities are fixed and known in advance

v2_human_g2_goal: the system determines whether a set of resource requests can be satisfied given available capacities without exceeding any resource. It also enforces that atleast one resource must remain strictly unallocated v2_human task for the allocation to be considered valid
v2_human_g2_input: resources: Dict[str, Num] → Mapping from resource name to total available capacity. requests: List[Dict[str, Num]] → List of requests. Each request is mapping from resource name to the amount required
v2_human_g2_output: True ⇒ allocation is feasible, False ⇒ Otherwise
